propositions: The complexity-baseline lock step executes redundantly four times (once per test matrix cell: Ubuntu 3.11/3.12/3.13 and macOS 3.12) instead of once per Verified change, consuming approximately 154 duplicate runner-seconds.
The lock is an OS/Python-invariant, commit-level policy with no platform or version-dependent behavior, so it should run exactly once in the single lint job rather than in each test matrix cell.
Moving the unchanged lock invocation from jobs.test to jobs.lint preserves the fail-closed gate, definition-vs-tree skew detection, and policy coverage while eliminating four duplicate executions.
Workflow unit tests must enforce exactly one lock invocation in lint and prohibit any invocation in the test matrix to prevent future reintroduction of the duplicate placement.
